g1|variants|partner determination.family_title: Partner Determination in Sales and Distribution
g1|variants|partner determination.summary: Partner determination assigns roles like Sold-to, Ship-to, Bill-to, and Payer to sales documents, ensuring proper document flow, pricing, and billing. Variants differ by partner function schema assignment level, automatic sourcing rules, and manual override capabilities.

variants.name: Standard Customer Master Partner Determination
variants.when_used: Standard sales orders where partners flow directly from customer master records assigned to the customer hierarchy.
variants.key_config: Assigned via Sales Area in Customizing (SPRO > Sales and Distribution > Basic Functions > Partner Determination > Set Up Partner Determination for Sales Documents).

variants.name: Contact Person Partner Determination
variants.when_used: Orders requiring specific individual contact persons linked to the customer master at header or item level.
variants.key_config: Partner function CP configured as optional with access sequence checking table KNVK (Customer Master Contact Persons).

variants.name: Personnel Partner Determination (Sales Representative)
variants.when_used: Orders where internal sales personnel or external sales agents need to be tracked for commission and reporting.
variants.key_config: Access sequence pointing to personnel master records (PA0002/PA0001) linked via user profile or customer master.

variants.name: Forwarding Agent Partner Determination in Deliveries
variants.when_used: Outbound deliveries requiring a specific carrier or forwarding agent copied from the sales order or determined in shipping.
variants.key_config: Partner procedure assigned to Delivery Type (e.g., LF) in SPRO Logistics Execution > Shipping > Partner Determination.

variants.name: Intercompany Billing Partner Determination
variants.when_used: Intercompany billing scenarios where ordering plant acts as customer or supplying plant acts as vendor.
variants.key_config: Partner procedure assigned to Billing Type (e.g., IV) linking supplying plant to internal customer number.

g1|core|partner determination|standard c.title: Standard Customer Master Partner Determination in Sales Documents
g1|core|partner determination|standard c.story: Imagine addressing a letter to the right person, making sure it goes to the right house, sending the bill to the accounts department, and receiving payment from the finance office, all automatically when you take an order. Technically, partner determination automatically populates mandatory sales document roles like Sold-to Party (AG), Ship-to Party (WE), Bill-to Party (RE), and Payer (RG) from the customer master records based on the sales area and partner procedure assignment.
g1|core|partner determination|standard c.why_business_needs_it: The business needs automated partner determination to ensure sales orders route correctly to the ordering entity, physical goods ship to the precise delivery plant or site, billing documents target the correct invoice recipient, and collections trace back to the right financial payer without manual user intervention. Correct partner determination prevents delivery routing errors, financial audit failures, and incorrect customer invoicing.

modules.role: Controls the partner determination procedure, partner functions, access sequences, and maps customer master partner functions into sales document headers and items.
modules.hands_off_to: FI-AR (Financial Accounting - Accounts Receivable) via the Payer and Bill-to roles for billing and collections.

modules.role: Receives accounting document postings driven by the Payer and Bill-to partner functions assigned during order processing and billing.
modules.hands_off_to: SD for credit management and billing status updates.

prerequisites: Customer Master Records created with appropriate roles for Sold-to, Ship-to, Bill-to, and Payer using transaction XD01 / BP.
Sales Organization, Distribution Channel, and Division assigned to Sales Area using transaction OVX6.
Sales Document Types configured (e.g., TA Standard Order) using transaction VOV8.

config_steps.step: Define Partner Functions AG, WE, RE, and RG
config_steps.where: VOPA -- SPRO > Sales and Distribution > Basic Functions > Partner Determination > Set Up Partner Determination
config_steps.values: Partner functions AG, WE, RE, RG mapped to partner type Customer (KU).
config_steps.check: Run transaction VOPA, select Partner Functions, and verify AG, WE, RE, RG appear in the overview list.
config_steps.why: System needs standard roles to route orders, deliveries, and invoices correctly through the Order-to-Cash chain.
config_steps.if_missing: Without defined partner functions, sales orders cannot identify who ordered or who pays, resulting in error message V1302.
actions: Enter transaction VOPA in the command field and press Enter
Select the radio button for Partner functions and double-click
Click on the New Entries button in the application toolbar
Type AG in the Part.Func. field and Sold-to party in the Name field
Select KU (Customer) in the Part.Type field
Type WE in the next row, Ship-to party as Name, and KU as Part.Type
Type RE in the third row, Bill-to party as Name, and KU as Part.Type
Type RG in the fourth row, Payer as Name, and KU as Part.Type
Click the Save button and assign a customizing transport request

fields.note: Partner function code for Sold-to party
Partner type Customer assigned to function

config_steps.step: Set Up Partner Determination Procedure TA
config_steps.where: VOPA -- SPRO > Sales and Distribution > Basic Functions > Partner Determination > Set Up Partner Determination
config_steps.values: Procedure TA created to group partner functions for sales document processing.
config_steps.check: Check table TPAER via transaction SE16N to confirm entry TA exists.
config_steps.why: Grouping functions into a procedure ensures all required roles are checked consistently when creating an OTC sales document.
config_steps.if_missing: Sales document types cannot be linked to partner rules, causing order creation dumps.
actions: Enter transaction VOPA in the command field and press Enter
Select the radio button for Partner determination procedures and double-click
Click on the New Entries button in the application toolbar
Type TA in the Partner Det.Procedure field
Type Standard Order Procedure in the Name field
Click the Save button and save your entries to the transport request

fields.note: Unique key for sales document partner procedure

config_steps.step: Assign Partner Functions to Procedure TA
config_steps.where: VOPA -- SPRO > Sales and Distribution > Basic Functions > Partner Determination > Set Up Partner Determination
config_steps.values: Procedure TA assigned functions AG, WE, RE, RG with flags for Not Modifiable and Mandatory.
config_steps.check: Select procedure TA in VOPA and verify all 4 functions display with mandatory and non-modifiable flags.
config_steps.why: Mandatory flags force users to provide ship-to and payer details, protecting downstream deliveries and billing runs.
config_steps.if_missing: Sales orders can be saved without a bill-to party, causing billing generation failures in VF01.
actions: Enter transaction VOPA in the command field and press Enter
Select Partner determination procedures and double-click
Highlight procedure TA in the left dialog structure and double-click on Partner func. in procedure
Click New Entries
Enter AG in Part.Func., check Not Mod. and Mand. checkboxes
Enter WE, RE, and RG in subsequent rows, checking Mand. and Not Mod. for each
Click the Save button to record changes

fields.note: Prevents manual deletion in sales order

config_steps.step: Set Up Access Sequences for Partner Determination
config_steps.where: VOPA -- SPRO > Sales and Distribution > Basic Functions > Partner Determination > Set Up Partner Determination
config_steps.values: Access sequence 01 configured with source access steps pointing to customer master tables.
config_steps.check: Inspect access sequence 01 in VOPA to ensure access table 304 is assigned.
config_steps.why: Access sequences define the search strategy for pulling partner data from customer master records.
config_steps.if_missing: System cannot search for partner master relationships automatically during sales order entry.
actions: Enter transaction VOPA in the command field and press Enter
Select Access sequences and double-click
Click New Entries
Enter 01 in the Access sequence field and Standard Partner Access in Description
Highlight access sequence 01 and double-click Accesses in the dialog structure
Click New Entries and enter Table 304 with Source Customer Master
Click the Save button

config_steps.step: Assign Partner Determination Procedure to Sales Document Header
config_steps.where: VOPA -- SPRO > Sales and Distribution > Basic Functions > Partner Determination > Set Up Partner Determination
config_steps.screen_title: Change View "Sales Document Header: Partner Procedure": Overview
config_steps.values: Sales Document Type TA mapped to Partner Determination Procedure TA.
config_steps.check: Run transaction VOV8, view order type TA, and confirm Partner Procedure TA is populated.
config_steps.why: Links the sales order document header directly to the partner rules set up for the OTC business process.
config_steps.if_missing: Creating standard order TA results in missing partner tabs and incomplete document errors.
actions: Enter transaction VOPA in the command field and press Enter
Select Assign partner proc. to sales doc. type and double-click
Scroll down to find Sales Document Type TA
Overwrite the Partner Procedure column for TA with procedure TA
Click the Save button and confirm transport request

config_steps.step: Assign Partner Determination Procedure to Sales Document Item
config_steps.where: VOPA -- SPRO > Sales and Distribution > Basic Functions > Partner Determination > Set Up Partner Determination
config_steps.screen_title: Change View "Sales Document Item: Partner Procedure": Overview
config_steps.values: Item Category TAN mapped to Partner Determination Procedure.
config_steps.check: Verify item category TAN has procedure TA assigned in view V_TVEPZ via transaction SM30.
config_steps.why: Enables item-level partner overrides for complex scenarios like drop-ships or split shipments.
config_steps.if_missing: Item-level partner determinations fail, causing split delivery creation errors.
actions: Enter transaction VOPA in the command field and press Enter
Select Assign partner proc. to item category and double-click
Locate Item Category TAN in the overview table
Enter procedure TA in the Partner Procedure column for item category TAN
Click the Save button

config_steps.step: Maintain Customer Master Partner Functions for Business Partner
config_steps.where: BP -- SAP Menu > Logistics > Sales and Distribution > Master Data > Business Partner > Maintain Business Partner
config_steps.values: Customer 100000 assigned Sales Area data with corresponding partner relationships for Ship-to, Bill-to, and Payer.
config_steps.check: Run transaction VA01, enter Sold-to 100000, and verify partner functions WE, RE, and RG populate automatically.
config_steps.why: Customer master partner relationships supply the physical delivery addresses and financial billing entities for the order.
config_steps.if_missing: Sales orders will not pull default ship-to addresses, halting outbound delivery creation in VL01N.
actions: Enter transaction BP in the command field and press Enter
Select customer Business Partner 100000 in Find dropdown and press Enter
Click on the Change button to switch to edit mode
Select Sales and Distribution role from the Role dropdown
Click on the Sales Area button and select Sales Org 1000, Dist.Chnl 10, Division 00
Click on the Partner Functions tab strip
Add relationship rows for WE (Ship-to), RE (Bill-to), and RG (Payer) with corresponding customer numbers
Click the Save button

run_steps.result: System creates sales order document TA and automatically populates Sold-to, Ship-to, Bill-to, and Payer partner functions from customer master.

run_steps.step: Verify Partners in Sales Order Header
run_steps.result: Displays the Partners tab at the header level showing roles AG, WE, RE, and RG populated with correct customer numbers.
System copies the Ship-to (WE) partner from the sales order to the delivery document header for picking and packing.
System uses the Bill-to (RE) and Payer (RG) partner functions from the sales order to generate the invoice and post to FI-AR.

errors.title: Mandatory Partner Function Missing in Customer Master
errors.plain_meaning: The system cannot create the sales order because a required business partner, such as the Ship-to party, is not linked to the customer master record.
errors.cause: The customer master record for the Sold-to party lacks an assigned partner function with mandatory status in partner determination procedure TA.
errors.config_step: Assign Partner Functions to Customer Master Record / Partner Determination Procedure TA
errors.verify: Re-run transaction VA01 to create a sales order for the customer; the system must populate all mandatory partner roles on the Header Partners tab without throwing an error.
errors.prevent: Ensure that the customer master creation template enforces the mandatory maintenance of all required partner roles (AG, WE, RE, RS) for procedure TA before rollout.
errors.ref_title: Partner Determination in Sales Documents - SAP Documentation

fix_steps.step: Open customer master data in transaction BP.
fix_steps.values: Select Customer Role (FI Customer / FLCU01), navigate to Customer: Sales Area -> Partner Functions tab.

fix_steps.step: Add missing mandatory partner function role (e.g., SH for Ship-to party).
fix_steps.values: Partner Function: SH, Number: assign valid customer number.

errors.title: Partner Determination Procedure Not Assigned to Sales Document Type
errors.message_text: Partner determination procedure for sales document type & not defined
errors.plain_meaning: The sales document type does not know which partner rules to follow, so the system stops processing.
errors.cause: The sales document type (e.g., OR) is not linked to partner determination procedure TA in Customizing.
errors.config_step: Assign Partner Determination Procedure to Sales Document Header
errors.verify: Execute VA01 with document type OR; the system should successfully load the partner determination procedure and display the partner tabs.
errors.prevent: Always include partner determination procedure assignments in baseline transport requests when creating custom sales document types.
errors.ref_title: Partner Determination Customizing - SAP Help Portal

fix_steps.step: Access Customizing activity for partner determination assignment.
fix_steps.where: SPRO -> Sales and Distribution -> Basic Functions -> Partner Determination -> Set Up Partner Determination -> Set Up Partner Determination for Sales Documents

fix_steps.values: Assign Partner Procedure TA to Sales Document Type OR.

errors.title: Partner Function Not Allowed for Account Group
errors.message_text: Partner function &1 is not allowed for customer account group &2
errors.plain_meaning: You are trying to use a partner role that is forbidden for this type of customer account group.
errors.cause: The customer account group configuration restricts the usage of specific partner functions (e.g., assigning a vendor-like partner role to a standard customer account group without permission).
errors.config_step: Define Account Groups and Field Selection for Customer
errors.verify: Re-open transaction BP and attempt to add the partner function; the system must accept the role without throwing an error.
errors.prevent: Align customer account group governance definitions with standard OTC partner determination requirements before master data load.

fix_steps.where: SPRO -> Logistics - General -> Business Partner -> Customers -> Control -> Define Account Groups and Field Selection for Customers

fix_steps.step: Verify permitted partner functions for the account group.
fix_steps.where: SPRO -> Partner Determination Assignment per Account Group
fix_steps.values: Enable the required partner function checkbox for the account group.

errors.title: Inconsistent Billing Partner Determination Causing Billing Block
errors.message_text: Partner &1 is not defined for billing document - billing blocked
errors.plain_meaning: The invoice cannot be created because the Bill-to or Payer partner data is invalid or missing at the billing stage.
errors.cause: The partner determination procedure for billing (e.g., procedure BI) failed to derive a valid Bill-to (RE) or Payer (RG) from the sales order header due to master data deletion or partner function mismatch.
errors.config_step: Set Up Partner Determination for Billing Documents
errors.verify: Re-attempt transaction VF01 for the billing due list; the billing document must be generated without partner errors.
errors.prevent: Ensure access sequences for billing partner determination point to valid copy control routines from sales order to billing document.

fix_steps.step: Review billing document partner procedure configuration.
fix_steps.where: SPRO -> Sales and Distribution -> Basic Functions -> Partner Determination -> Set Up Partner Determination -> Set Up Partner Determination for Billing Documents
fix_steps.values: Verify procedure BI includes RE and RG as mandatory.
Navigate to Header -> Partners, ensure Bill-to (RE) and Payer (RG) are populated and valid.

errors.title: Partner Function Access Sequence Error in Delivery
errors.message_text: Error in partner determination for delivery type LF
errors.plain_meaning: The delivery document cannot be created because the system cannot find the Ship-to party using the access sequence rules.
errors.cause: The access sequence linked to the partner function in delivery partner determination procedure (e.g., standard delivery procedure) returned no valid partner record from the preceding sales order or customer master.
errors.config_step: Define Partner Determination Procedures for Deliveries
errors.verify: Run transaction VL01N for the sales order; the outbound delivery should be created successfully with the Ship-to party automatically determined.
errors.prevent: Test copy control settings from sales order to delivery to ensure partner functions are mapped seamlessly.
errors.ref_title: Shipping Partner Determination - SAP Help Portal

fix_steps.where: SPRO -> Logistics Execution -> Shipping -> Basic Functions -> Partner Determination -> Set Up Partner Determination for Deliveries
fix_steps.values: Select procedure for delivery type LF.
Ensure access steps correctly check preceding document tables (VBPA).

errors.title: Multiple Mandatory Partner Functions Found without Unique Indicator
errors.message_text: Several partners of function &1 exist; check selection
errors.plain_meaning: The system found more than one matching partner for a role that only allows one, so a user must manually pick the correct one.
errors.cause: The partner determination procedure contains a partner function configured without the 'Unique' flag, and multiple valid master records match the access sequence.
errors.verify: Create a new sales order in VA01; the system should automatically select the unique partner without issuing a warning or forcing a manual pop-up.
errors.prevent: Ensure unique partner functions like Sold-to (AG) always have the unique indicator enabled in custom partner procedures.
errors.ref_title: Partner Determination Procedure Setup - SAP Help

fix_steps.where: SPRO -> Sales and Distribution -> Basic Functions -> Partner Determination -> Set Up Partner Determination -> Set Up Partner Determination for Sales Documents
fix_steps.values: Select procedure TA and click Partner Functions in Procedure.

fix_steps.step: Set the Unique flag for the affected partner function.
fix_steps.values: Check the 'Unique' indicator for the respective function row.
